messages:
Lina (Docs): Heads-up — three docs PRs need reviewers before tomorrow's merge window: PR#482, PR#489, PR#493. PR#482 (migration guide) failing docs preview linkcheck. :eyes:
AJ (Platform): Which ones are blocking release? I can take one.
Lina (Docs): PR#482 is blocking the release notes. PR#489 is an SDK snippet update (smaller), PR#493 is link fixes (quick). Ideally someone can do a re-check on preview and approve by EOD.
Mike R: I'll pick up PR#482. Preview URL shows 404 on `/api/dedicated` — looks like path changed after the router refactor.
CI Bot: build-preview/pr-482: linkcheck failed
```
Linkcheck error: GET /api/dedicated -> 404 Not Found
File: content/migration/dedicated.md line 34
```
Tara: I can take PR#493 (link fixes) and do a quick sweep for other broken links :thumbsup:
Sam: For PR#489 (SDK snippets) can someone confirm the python snippet uses the latest SDK shape? I saw `client.generate` vs `client.responses.create` inconsistency.
AJ (Platform): I'll review PR#489 after lunch. Quick note — we have a docs-review rotation gap next week (holiday), we should add temporary backup reviewers.
Lina (Docs): Agreed. Quick plan: Mike -> PR#482, AJ -> PR#489, Tara -> PR#493. Mike, after you fix the path I'll re-run the preview. Also proposing a week-of rotation schedule: add Tara as backup Mon-Wed and AJ Thu-Fri. Thoughts?
Mike R: Found it — the route moved to `/v2/dedicated` in the runtime. I'll update the migration doc and push.
Lina (Docs): Thanks — preview after push: https://deploy-preview-482.docs.redwood.local
CI Bot: preview redeployed: https://deploy-preview-482.docs.redwood.local — linkcheck passed :white_check_mark:
Lina (Docs): OK merging window at 16:00 PT. I'll merge PR#482 once AJ approves PR#489 and Tara confirms PR#493.
Tara: Confirmed PR#493 merged.
AJ (Platform): Approved PR#489. Good to go :rocket:
Lina (Docs): All set — thanks team. I'll follow up about formalizing the reviewer rotation and add to the reviewer tracker: https://go/reviewers
